description.value: Resurrection Spirits is a small-batch craft distillery located in East Vancouver's industrial district at the north end of Commercial Drive, producing gin, rye whisky, and vodka using 100% BC rye grain. The operation draws on Vancouver's Prohibition-era drinking culture and pairs an on-site lounge with distillery production. Cyclists exploring East Van have a locally owned destination for craft spirits in a distinctive industrial setting.
